sources.entry: Winds - A Beautiful Open Source RSS & Podcast App Powered by Getstream.io

summary.one_liner: Winds is an open-source RSS and podcast reader app built with React, Redux and Express.js, powered by Stream, Algolia and MongoDB, and no longer maintained.
summary.what_it_does: Winds is a web and Electron desktop app for following RSS feeds and podcasts, with a frontend in React and Redux and an Express.js API. Its backend runs workers that process RSS and podcast feeds, queued through Bull on Redis, and parses articles with Mercury. Stream provides activity feeds and follow suggestions, Algolia powers search, and MongoDB stores users, feeds, episodes and articles. The README also describes a podcast player, RSS recommendations, and a debugging CLI with commands for RSS, podcast, Open Graph, discovery and article parsing. A notice at the top says the repository is no longer maintained and will not accept issues or pull requests.
use_cases: Reading RSS feeds in one place
Listening to podcasts in an app
Learning a React/Express codebase with Stream and Algolia integrations
how_to_run: Create a .env file in app/ with MongoDB, Redis, Stream and Algolia keys
notable: Activity feeds and follow suggestions built on the Stream API
Full-text search through Algolia's JavaScript client
Debugging CLI commands for RSS, podcasts, Open Graph and article parsing
Reference to a hosted free version and the option to self-host
Tutorials section with a dozen blog-post links about the stack
caveats: The repository is no longer maintained; no new issues or pull requests will be considered.
Running locally requires accounts and API keys for Stream and Algolia, plus MongoDB and Redis.
The README says the roadmap items (team support, React Native mobile app, playlists) are unfinished.
